title: Domain-published relationships make management topology discoverable
summary: Authoritative objects publish typed relationships and provenance. Management performs bounded generic traversal while treating relationship names as opaque, then discovers transient specialist intention surfaces from reached objects.
invariants: Management must not hard-code that an MVS guest runs inside Hercules or that Hercules runs on a cloud host.
Relationship direction, authority and evidence are preserved even when traversal is bidirectional for reachability.
Management must not manufacture inverse relationships.
Being related does not automatically make an object's intention surface relevant to the user's request.
Related-object specialist advertisements are transient to the exploration and do not become global permanent capability.
Relationship graphs are rediscovered so removed topology does not remain operational truth.

provenance.claim: Qualified relationship discovery, bounded exploration and related-surface advertisement.
